user.title: Set up Spotify Statistics
user.description: Enter your Spotify username and polling intervals. After submitting, you'll be redirected to Spotify to authorize access.

data_description.now_playing_interval: How often to check what's currently playing (30-300 seconds)
data_description.recently_played_interval: How often to check recently played tracks (300-3600 seconds)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Spotify Statistics
reauth_confirm.description: Your Spotify Statistics connection for **{username}** needs to be re-authorized - Spotify rejected the stored refresh token. Click Submit to be redirected to Spotify to log in again.

abort.already_configured: This Spotify account is already configured
abort.missing_credentials: Application Credentials not configured. Please go to Settings → Devices & Services → Application Credentials and add your Spotify Client ID and Client Secret first.
abort.oauth_error: OAuth authorization failed. Please try again.

init.title: Spotify Statistics Options
init.description: Update polling intervals for this account.

application_credentials.description: Follow the [Spotify Developer Dashboard setup instructions]({oauth_url}) to create an application and get your Client ID and Client Secret. Use this redirect URI: **{redirect_uri}**

export_followed_artists.name: Export Followed Artists
export_followed_artists.description: Export all followed artists with complete metadata to a JSON file.

username.name: Username
username.description: Spotify username to export data for.

filepath.name: File Path
filepath.description: Absolute path to save the JSON file.

export_saved_library.name: Export Saved Library
export_saved_library.description: Export saved albums and tracks with complete metadata to a JSON file.

username.name: Username
username.description: Spotify username to export data for.

filepath.name: File Path
filepath.description: Absolute path to save the JSON file.

export_playlists.name: Export Playlists

filepath.name: File Path

include_audio_features.description: Fetch audio analysis data (danceability, energy, etc.). This is slower.

set_update_interval.name: Set Update Interval
set_update_interval.description: Dynamically adjust update intervals for a user's sensors.

username.name: Username
username.description: Spotify username to update intervals for.

now_playing_interval.name: Now Playing Interval
now_playing_interval.description: Update interval in seconds for now playing sensor (30-300).

recently_played_interval.name: Recently Played Interval
recently_played_interval.description: Update interval in seconds for recently played sensor (300-3600).

refresh_now_playing.name: Refresh Now Playing
refresh_now_playing.description: Immediately refresh the now playing sensor for a user.
